claims.statement: EU guidance permits food no longer marketable for people, such as unsold bread or broken biscuits, to be used as animal feed when safe and legally compliant.
Feed businesses must use registered or approved establishments and maintain hygiene, HACCP where applicable, and traceability controls.
Demand hypothesis: feed processors will reserve consistent side streams when historical composition and rejection evidence are available.

contrary_evidence: Human redistribution ranks above feed use when food remains suitable.
Animal-derived inputs and contaminated or mixed streams face additional prohibitions and controls.

economics.acquisition_route: Demand hypothesis: one regional bakery or brewery network plus two registered feed processors can seed a repeat corridor
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 30m PLN annual GMV at 4% plus 200 generators at 1000 PLN monthly yields 3.6m PLN revenue; 25% EBITDA at a 6x marketplace value could exceed 5m PLN in 5-7 years
economics.founder_time: 15-20 hours weekly; food and feed safety decisions require qualified partners
economics.gross_margin_basis: Economics hypothesis: 65-80% after lab and onboarding costs, with haulage contracted directly between parties
economics.payback: Economics hypothesis: 25 generators at 1500 PLN monthly recover initial capital within 12-18 months after validation costs
economics.pricing: Economics hypothesis: 1000-2500 PLN monthly per generator plus 3-5% of offtake GMV
economics.retention_or_repeat: Daily or weekly production, batch records, seasonal forecasting, and recurring buyer demand

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Stream-specific quality history, approved recipient graph, seasonal supply forecasts, and actual rejection data
fingerprint.customer: Food manufacturers with safe former foodstuffs, registered feed businesses, farms, and specialist processors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Food-industry clusters, feed advisers, veterinary registers, labs, baker and brewer associations
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Stream approval workflow, batch records, sample scheduling, registered-counterparty checks, forward reservations, and recall-ready traceability
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Generator pays a monthly stream fee and either party pays a transaction fee on a contracted offtake
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A safe recurring side stream loses food-market value but cannot enter feed without reliable specifications, traceability, and eligible counterparties

founder_fit: FMCG adjacency without using employer data
Regional corridor can be tested part-time

structure.commercial_archetype: Regulated side-stream marketplace with forward contracts
structure.control_point: Recurring generator authorization bound to batch traceability and an eligible receiver
structure.critical_dependency: Each material and operator must remain lawful under food, feed, waste, and animal-by-product rules

thesis: Bakeries, breweries, and food factories authorize recurring side-stream listings with batch composition, safety, traceability, and registered-recipient checks; feed operators reserve forward volumes. Demand hypothesis: normalized quality and repeat rights can outperform spot waste brokerage for safe non-animal former foodstuffs.
title: Former-Food-to-Feed Forward Offtake Exchange
